jobs.occupation: Carrier for night distribution at dao
jobs.description:
Carrier for night distribution, enjoy freedom and fast-paced work and become one of the starts of the night

The faster you work, the more you earn. Does that sound right up your alley?

If you enjoy freedom with responsibility as well as working in the quiet of the night while others sleep, we would love to have you on board.

At dao, you will get:

• A flexible night job with around 32 hours per week

• Good training from day one and a supportive community

• Piecework pay as you deliver newspapers, letters, magazines and parcels by bike, scooter or car.

• Salary and conditions in accordance with the agreement with the workers union 3F

We deliver every night and all year

As a Danish delivery company, dao brings newspapers, letters, magazines, and parcels to people all over the country 365 days a year.

Even though you will be working on your own, you will never feel alone. Because your manager and the rest of your team is there for you.

Deliver at night while others sleep

Before you start, you will receive training to feel confident in your role. You will also by supported by an experienced colleague, and your manager will check in with you to make sure you are settling in well.

During your shift you will:

• Pack your bike, scooter or car with newspapers, letters, parcels and magazines.

• Follow your route and deliver to doors and mailboxes

• Keep a good pace and meet deadlines

Not a resident? Not a problem!

If you do not live in Denmark, we will help you get settled. Because we know moving to a new country is not easy. During the interview we will tell you much more.

You enjoy working at night in all kinds of weather, and you:

• Are steady, responsible, and deliver with care and accuracy

• Can speak either English and/or Danish

Ready to become our newest night owl?

Then click “Apply” and attach your application and CV.

We encourage everyone, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, sexual, political and cultural orientation, to apply for the job with us.

We look forward to hearing from you.

What We’re Looking For

We need a manager who combines operational excellence with a love for music and culture. The ideal candidate has:

• Restaurant management experience – you know how to run a smooth, profitable operation.
• Hands-on service background
• A background in music or cultural studies – formal education or significant practical experience in music, arts, or event curation is a strong plus.
• Excellent language skills – fluent in English and Chinese (to communicate with our team, including chefs and staff). Danish is a big advantage, as it helps with local suppliers and daily interactions.
 
Your Responsibilities
As our Restaurant Manager, you will be the driving force behind our new concept. Your key tasks will include:

• Designing and implementing the music-restaurant concept – curating playlists, planning live or DJ events, and aligning the audio experience with our brand.
• Creating staff rotas – ensuring optimal coverage while respecting work-life balance.
• Leading service-quality training – coaching the team to deliver warm, professional, and consistent service.
• Working closely with the kitchen team – ensuring seamless coordination between front-of-house and back-of-house for a flawless end-to-end guest journey.
• Overseeing daily operations – from opening procedures to guest relations, inventory, and health & safety standards.
We offer:

• ·         Competitive salary
• ·         Opportunity for career development
• ·         Work in an exciting and dynamic environment
• ·         Training and support from our experienced team

Ready to Make Some Noise?

If you’re excited to lead a restaurant that sings – literally and figuratively – we’d love to hear from you.

Please send your CV and a brief cover letter (in English) explaining your experience in management, service, and music/culture toramencopenhagen@gmail.com.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Electronics Engineer for Manufacturing Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an engineering role where you help turn advanced sports technology into scalable, high-quality products? At Trackman, you will play a key role in industrializing, testing, and producing innovative hardware solutions bridging R&D and production with real technical influence and cross-functional impact.

Your Role

As an experienced Engineer in “Manufacturing Engineering” which is a part of the “Hardware Development & Supply” organization, you will act as a key technical contributor across R&D and Production. Your responsibilities will be to ensure that Trackman’s new and existing hardware platforms can be produced reliably, at scale and volume.

You will be expected to ensure design for manufacturing (DFM).  This involves challenge designs, propose improvements, and drive best practices across the organization in close collaboration with R&D hardware, tracking and software teams, in-house production, EMS suppliers, supply chain, and management.

This role suits an experienced engineer who enjoys combining hands-on engineering with technical expertise and ownership.

What you will be doing

• 
Specifying, developing, and driving a strategy for production- and test engineering equipment to support new and existing hardware platforms. We work with GHZ Radars, Computer Modules, Camera Sensors and other state of the art electronics.

• 
Act as an experienced technical interface between R&D and Production, ensuring manufacturability and testability are built in from early design phases.

• 
Design, build and validate production- and test solutions for all relevant technologies. This includes fixtures for assemblies, automation, “bed of nails” setups, and other supporting electronics.

• 
Develop automated test solutions using NI TestStand, Python, and C#, including data handling, traceability, and statistical analysis.

• 
Perform hands-on debugging utilizing signal generators, spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes ect. for root-cause analysis.

• 
Participate in schematic entry, reviews, placement and carry out layout and routing of simple PCBs used in test fixtures and support electronics

• 
Drive collaboration with EMS suppliers, including transfer, ramp-up, and continuous improvement of test and production processes

• 
Analyze production and test data to improve yield, quality, and robustness, and to support data-driven decision-making

• 
Strengthen the ability to plan and execute according to plan, i.e. spending part of your time doing project coordination work supporting the whole team.

Job requirements

What You Bring

We imagine that you:

• 
Hold a degree in Electronics Engineering and have extensive experience (5+ years) within electronics development, production, or test engineering

• 
Have strong practical experience with test development, electronics debugging, and production environments

• 
Advanced user of relevant lab test equipment (e.g., oscilloscope, signal generators, spectrum analyzers etc.)

• 
Are comfortable taking technical ownership and influencing decisions across teams and senior stakeholders

• 
Work in a structured, proactive way and naturally drive improvements

• 
Fluent in Danish and English, written and spoken and located in Denmark

Technical skills:

• 
Advanced experience with Python, NI TestStand, C# and data analysis.

• 
Experience with RF measurements in the GHz range and understanding of schematics.

• 
Experience in implementing test equipment at EMS suppliers, transferring test data between different sites

• 
Knowledge of camera and optics calibration principles.

The Office

We are located in our state-of-art HQ in Hørsholm, located at DTU Science Park. We take great pride in the building we designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness centre, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you.

Developing great products for sports applications in a highly technical and dynamic environment?

Join us on our journey to enable athletes around the world with actionable, data-driven insights. Trackman is expanding with an additional Project Lead to lead the development of our next-generation modular hardware platform designed to serve multiple sports applications, from idea generation through production and into the field. Being a Hardware Project Lead at Trackman requires you to work closely together with several senior stakeholders in a very dynamic environment – driven by our passion for the product, the customer and sports.

The position is in the R&D Hardware department, working closely with all hardware teams – mechanics, optics, electronics, and certification – as well as our close colleagues in embedded software, tracking algorithm teams, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, and production.

The workplace for this position is at our HQ in Science Park DTU in Hørsholm.

Your key responsibilities are

• 
Lead the hardware project group together with the Product Owner(s), developing next-generation hardware for golf and other sports applications.

• 
Translate customer and business needs into clear technical requirements and hardware architecture.

• 
Collaborate with stakeholders across Management, Business Development, Tracking, and Manufacturing to align priorities and ensure progress.

• 
Turn technical requirements into actionable tasks, manage resources and dependencies, and maintain the overall hardware project plan.

• 
Represent Trackman in technical discussions with suppliers, including specifications, quality issues, and expectations.

• 
Communicate project status, progress, risks, and key obstacles clearly to management and other stakeholders.

• 
Coordinate international product certifications, including CE, FCC, and UL, together with the Certification team.

• 
Identify and manage hardware risks related to areas such as product quality, obsolescence, suppliers, and certifications.

Job requirements

Are you our new colleague?

We’re looking for an experienced project manager with a strong hardware engineering background who can bridge technical complexity, business needs, and collaboration. Ideally, you bring:

• 
Several years of project management experience in hardware product development, preferably with RF systems.

• 
Experience with complex projects across mechanics, electronics, RF, and embedded software.

• 
Strong understanding of requirements management, design verification, and product industrialization.

• 
Solid business acumen and the ability to translate diverse user needs into robust product solutions.

• 
Experience with project management methodologies and Agile principles, ideally bringing complex electronics products to market.

• 
Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, knowing when to listen, challenge, and take the lead.

Who is Trackman

Trackman is a privately-owned company founded in 2003. The company has experienced consistent high growth driven by a market-leading sports ball tracking technology based on radar and vision tracking, sustained by a strong desire to innovate.

The company employs globally more than 1000+ employees and has offices in Denmark (headquarter in Hørsholm), Aarhus, US (Connecticut and Arizona), Japan, South Korea, and Poland.

While being active in multiple sports including baseball, football, and soccer, Trackman is first and foremost a golf company. Trackman has revolutionised the way golf players train and instructors teach, and is now broadening the technology so all golfers can take advantage – whether they are playing indoors, on driving ranges, or on the golf course.

In baseball, Trackman is the leading technology company in the world with solutions for practice, games, and the largest data sharing network, monetised by selling draft data on amateur players to the Major League Baseball teams. Trackman has also developed practice solutions for American Football and Soccer that are now used among top teams.

Trackman has the largest R&D capacity in the industry and is constantly aiming to push the boundaries for sports, technology, and data. We strive to recruit the best talent from around the world for R&D functions such as Hardware. At our HQ in Denmark, we have an R&D team of more than 250 FTEs representing more than 40 countries around the world. Trackman designs, develops, and produces all of our technology from start to finish in-house under one roof.

Trackman’s 12,500 m² state-of-the-art CO₂-neutral headquarter is located in Science Park DTU in Hørsholm.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

At Paychex Europe, we simplify payroll, HR and workforce management for businesses across Europe. We believe great results come from people who take ownership, share knowledge, challenge the status quo and treat colleagues and customers with honesty and respect. These behaviors shape our culture and reflect the values we live by: Integrity, Respect, Partnership, Curiosity, Accountability and Service.

When you join our team, you can make a mark by helping us deliver solutions that make work easier for businesses and their employees.

Student Assistant – Online Marketing

Support our online marketing team across Denmark and Germany with hands-on execution in SEO, social media, paid campaigns, and reporting.

Paychex Europe is growing its digital presence across two markets, and our online marketing team is looking for an extra pair of skilled hands to help keep momentum. As our markets evolve and content demands increase, we need someone who can hit the ground running on execution.

As our Student Assistant in Online Marketing, you will work closely with our online and field marketing as well as product marketing teams. You will own recurring tasks across SEO, social media, campaign support, and competitor monitoring - and you will see the direct impact of your work on our digital channels. This is a role with real responsibility, not just support work, and a great opportunity to build hands-on B2B marketing experience across two European markets.

About our products

Paychex Europe offers a full suite of HR, payroll and workforce management solutions for businesses in Denmark and Germany – including Lessor Payroll, Emply People, Danløn, and Paychex Europe Payroll. Our customers range from small businesses to mid-sized enterprises, and our marketing helps them discover how we can make their work easier.

What you will do

You will support our online marketing team across Denmark and Germany with execution across four key areas. You will take ownership of recurring tasks and contribute directly to our digital performance. Your responsibilities will include:

• SEO & content

• Review and improve SEO elements across our website: meta titles, H1s, internal links, and image alt texts

• Audit our content for language coverage gaps between the Danish and German versions of the site and flag priorities to the team

• Social media

• Maintain and execute the content calendar for LinkedIn and Meta across both markets

• Produce social assets in Canva and/or Photoshop for organic posts and paid campaigns

• Publish approved content on schedule and monitor engagement

• Paid & website support

• Write ad copy variations and landing page headlines for A/B testing

• Produce visual assets for paid campaigns, including banners and ad creatives

• Reporting & competitor monitoring

• Compile a weekly performance snapshot across organic and social channels

• Run a regular competitor scan and support monthly reporting for the DK and DE markets

What will help you succeed

We encourage you to apply even if you don't tick every single box. The following experience and skills will help you succeed in this role:

• Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's programme in marketing, digital media, communications, or similar

• Comfortable writing in English; fluent Danish is required, German is a strong plus

• Detail-oriented with a sharp eye for copy, consistency, and structure

• Fast at execution and not afraid to try new things

• Self-driven and reliable - you manage your own time and deliver on time

• Some familiarity with tools like Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Google Analytics, or LinkedIn — we'll teach the rest

What we offer

• Real responsibility from day one, not just support tasks

• Broad exposure to B2B digital marketing: SEO, paid media, social, and reporting

• A senior team that takes your development seriously

• Flexible hours built around your study schedule

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Allerød (hybrid)

Hours: 15 hours per week

We value different perspectives and believe diverse teams make better decisions. If this role interests you and you can see yourself contributing to our team, we encourage you to apply!

For questions about the role, please do not hesitate to contact Edyta Tomaszewska etomaszewska@paychex.eu. Applications are reviewed continuously, and we look forward to meeting candidates who are excited about this opportunity.

Respect and partnership are at the heart of how we work together. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, religion or background. At Paychex Europe, we strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute and thrive. Our hiring decisions are based on skills, experience and potential.

Join Saxo’s Enterprise Identity & Data Security (EIDS) team and play a pivotal role in protecting the bank’s most valuable asset it’s data.

About the role

In this role, you will design and implement advanced data protection controls across modern security platforms, with a strong focus on Microsoft Purview and insider risk solutions. You will translate complex regulatory and data risk requirements into scalable, effective technical controls that safeguard sensitive information and strengthen Saxo’s security posture.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to Saxo’s broader agenda around security, governance, and operational resilience within a highly regulated financial environment, working closely with stakeholders across technology, compliance, and the business.

Your responsibilities

As a Senior Data Security Engineer, you will:

• Design and implement data protection controls across Microsoft Purview (DLP, Information Protection, Insider Risk Management)

• Translate data security risks and regulatory requirements into robust, enforceable technical solutions

• Lead and support the rollout and optimisation of Insider Risk Management and user activity monitoring tools (e.g. Teramind)

• Drive data discovery, classification, and visibility across structured and unstructured data environments

• Monitor, tune, and continuously improve the effectiveness of data protection policies and controls

• Collaborate with security, compliance, and business stakeholders to mitigate data risks and strengthen governance frameworks

Your profile

We are looking for a proactive and technically strong professional who can balance risk, regulation, and real-world implementation:

• 7–10 years of experience in data security or information security engineering

• Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Purview (DLP, labelling, Insider Risk)

• Strong understanding of data protection risks, insider threats, and mitigation strategies

• Experience working in regulated environments (financial services is an advantage)

• Solid knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure, and enterprise security tooling

• Experience with automation or scripting (e.g. PowerShell, APIs) is a plus

• Relevant certifications such as SC-400 are preferred

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply :

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

Would you like the opportunity to get some hands-on experience in finance business partnering and lay the foundation for a career in Finance? Do you want to create real impact by identifying key cost and value drivers? Do you want to become a part of an international company that contributes to the green transition?

Here is what the job entails

As our student worker in Controlling, you will play a key role in supporting our Finance Business Partnering team by handling data, conducting analysis, and collaborating with stakeholders to solve business challenges. You will be ensuring timely and high-quality execution of tasks, while contributing to process improvements through data modelling. Furthermore, you will be assisting with various tasks such as creating instructions as well as supporting team members during peak loads.

More specifically, you will be:

• Ensuring accuracy and quality in resource allocation data

• Keeping Project data up to date, including control of capitalization on projects

• Supporting the maintenance and reporting on our Standard Cost

• Assisting the team with various analysis, modelling and controlling activities

In this role, you will gain hands-on experience with financial controlling and data-driven decision-making in an international company. You will develop strong analytical and stakeholder management skills while working closely with experienced colleagues on real business challenges.

Meet your future team

You will join our Finance Business Partnering team of 9 colleagues, who act as the primary Finance stakeholders for each Division and Functional Area across Kamstrup. Our focus is to ensure the highest quality of business reporting, which in turn allows us to use the data for problem solving to create real value for the company. Our team is offered a lot of responsibility, which in turn means that we set the bar high for ourselves and the results that we produce. Despite this, we have an informal atmosphere in the team, where inputs and perspectives from all team members are highly valued.

Did you know? Our team is quite diverse in terms of personality types, making collaboration in the team, and the solutions we produce, much more dynamic.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for an enthusiastic and ambitious student who is eager to apply their knowledge of finance and business controlling while making a real impact on our team. You take pride in your work and have a great overview and structured approach, ensuring that your deadlines are met with a high degree of quality.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying a degree in Economics, Business Administration, or another relevant field

• Are curious and enjoy proactively seeking new challenges where you can gain knowledge and new perspectives

• Have a structured approach to your work and thrive in managing your tasks efficiently and effectively

• Enjoy collaboration and have good communication skills, enabling you to interact and build relationships within and outside of Kamstrup

• Are well acquainted with Excel and other MS office tools

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

We are more than an ordinary workplace

We offer a challenging student job in an international company where you are given independent responsibility for specific assignments, and where you can transform your theoretical knowledge into practical experience. As a student worker, you will be treated as an integrated part of the team, equal to other employees, ensuring a steep learning curve.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work-life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

Please submit your application using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks. This is a part-time position of approximately 15 hours per week. Your working hours will be agreed individually, with flexibility during examination periods.

The position is based at Kamstrup’s headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Director, Controlling, Thomas Vithen Jespersen, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00

Are you a design or verification engineer with ASIC/FPGA skills, and do you have a flair for client communication? If so, then SyoSil has a great career opportunity for you.

SyoSil will soon initiate a new project, for which we search for new team members to join our existing staff of 20 highly qualified ASIC engineers. We both look for seniors as well as newly graduated engineers.

The project will focus on digital design and verification for an RF radio ASIC, being part of a large international multi-team project. In this project, SyoSil will assume the full responsibility of several IP blocks, from architecture definition towards RTL design and coverage driven verification closure. Design and verification will be done using SystemVerilog and UVM. The project management will be SCRUM based.

We offer:

• A challenging role where you work closely with a highly skilled team as well as interfacing to engineers in leading international companies

• Access to the latest technologies and ongoing professional development, including training with ASIC tools from the top EDA vendors in the SyoSil partnership portfolio

• A competitive salary and a flexible working environment

SyoSil is a market leader in the ASIC R&D space, including RTL design/verification, device firmware and tool development. Our clients include top European and U.S. semiconductor companies working in specialized fields, such as the automotive, surveillance and telecommunication industries.

**Join an international team of specialists

**

You will join a young and dynamic team of 20 engineers in a vibrant international environment close to central Copenhagen, Denmark. Contributing to large-scale project execution, you will collaborate closely with experienced and highly skilled colleagues who are all specialists within their field, giving you a unique opportunity to learn and grow.

**Take part in large-scale project execution

**

As an ASIC/FPGA design and verification engineer, you will contribute to execution of projects on a large industrial scale, from concept and specification through RTL design to verification based on coverage closure. You will also deliver turn-key verification flows, verification IP and lead projects based on established and upcoming industry standards (SystemVerilog/UVM), helping clients improve their design and verification methodologies.

In relation to this, you can look forward to some international travel to liaise with clients and project execution.

**The ideal candidate

**

Experience from the industry is a plus, but not essential. What matters most is that you are skilled within ASIC/FPGA design, thoroughly systematic in your work and know how to solve parallel problems simultaneously. Are you passionate about finding new drug opportunities? Do you love understanding disease biology to guide the best possible drug design? Are you a seasoned professional and looking for the next step?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Associate Director, Product Innovation.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and expanded portfolio. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Ascendis Pharma is expanding our Product Innovation department and searching for an Associate Director to help drive the future pipeline and the company’s growth towards 2030 and beyond.

The Product Innovation department’s primary objective is to conduct analysis and propose new potential products for the company pipeline. With Patients in mind, new lead finding is based on thorough analysis which typically includes disease biology, unmet medical need, market assessment, competitive intelligence, FTO and assessment of path to FiH. With “Science” as a fundamental corporate value, analysis is rooted in a deep biological understanding of the disease, available (pre)clinical data, Mode of Action across modalities/lines of treatment and the impact a given molecular design/TPP will achieve. As a critical function to building Ascendis Pharma’s future, the Product Innovation department has high exposure to executive management and works closely with adjacent functions.

The Associate Director Product Innovation will play a critical role in Ascendis' success in Endocrinology Rare Disease as well as novel therapeutic areas. She/He will be the driving force behind providing high-quality analysis and pitch decks which enable value-oriented and informed decision-making by the EMT. By gathering, analyzing, and transforming data into concise, actionable ideas, you will play an important role in shaping the future pipeline.

You will be joining the Product Innovation team and report directly to Steffen Nyegaard, Director, Product Innovation who is based in Hellerup_. You will also be based in Hellerup.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Identification of new drug candidates and indications of interest

• In-depth analysis of diseases, treatment guidelines, competitive environment, how different MoA will affect the disease pathology, market and patents into final reports

• Act as strategic thought partner across different functions and teams, e.g. supporting early research projects or conducting deep-dive analytics to support key business decisions

• Staying current in relevant fields and tracking news widely (e.g., scientific literature, analyst reports, regulatory documents) and share findings with key stakeholders

• Establish processes, structures, and templates when necessary to support Ascendis' growth

Qualifications and Skills:

You have a PhD in life sciences and preferably post doctorial experience from a leading university or group. The ideal candidate has significant experience in lead finding and drug development and knows how to leverage their knowledge into actionable outcomes. The candidate possesses a strong biological profile, which enables them to quickly learn and understand novel biological systems, identify critical issues and unmet needs, and generate analyses with high level take-home and next-step recommendations.

Ideally**, you have:**

• 5 years of industry experience from Pharma or biotech within research or BD

• A strong biological profile with documented track record from the apex of the field

• Significant work experience with the different functions within the pharma value chain

• Experience in the use of public and private databases (e.g. Patsnap, Cortellis, Globaldata, Evaluate or similar)

• The ability to synthesize complex information to both high scientific and layman levels and present it in a clear, actionable manner

• English at a professional level, both written and spoken, and you master MS Office

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

You are passionate about science, love learning and have a deep understanding of disease biology

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to demonstrate strong stakeholder management and communication skills, high personal and scientific integrity and the ability to navigate complex environments.

Travel: 20-30days per year.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup, Denmark

About the job

Flatpay has become one of Europe's fastest-growing payment companies by helping merchants accept card payments in-store.

Our Point of Sale system serves as the central engine of the business. It streamlines the merchant's entire workflow — from order taking, product and inventory management, to payment processing, reporting, and compliance.

Some of the core capabilities include:

As our merchants grow, so does the platform. Every new market introduces new payment methods, fiscal requirements and merchant needs. Ballerup / Egtved

Denmark is undergoing a historic transformation of its energy system. As the owner and operator of Denmark's electricity and gas transmission infrastructure, Energinet plays a pivotal role in developing the solutions that will support the country's transition to a greener energy future.

One of Energinet's most ambitious projects is the establishment of the Danish Hydrogen Backbone – Denmark's future national hydrogen transmission infrastructure, designed to connect the production, consumption and export of green hydrogen. The project will play a vital role in both Denmark's and Europe's green transition and represents one of the country's most complex energy infrastructure projects today.

We are now looking for an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to play a key role in this landmark project. Beyond contributing to the successful delivery of the Danish Hydrogen Backbone, we are looking for someone who is motivated by the opportunity to become a long-term part of Energinet and help shape Denmark's critical energy infrastructure for years to come.

Lead electrical engineering in a landmark energy infrastructure project

As part of the Engineering department in Gas Transmission, you will serve as the Electrical Engineering Discipline Lead for the Project Danish Hydrogen Backbone project.

You will play a key role in the development of the electrical systems for the project's hydrogen stations, where hydrogen will be received, regulated and transported safely. Acting as a key technical authority, you will contribute throughout the entire project lifecycle, from detailed design and technical clarification to construction, commissioning and handover to operations.

You will join a multidisciplinary project environment, working closely with specialists in Instrumentation, SCADA, Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Technical Safety and Asset Management, as well as Energinet's international EPCM partner and other external consultants.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the technical solutions in a project where quality, safety and long-term reliability are critical to success.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
acting as the Electrical Engineering Discipline Lead throughout the design, construction and commissioning phases

• 
reviewing and approving technical solutions, drawings and engineering documentation

• 
defining technical requirements and documentation standards

• 
ensuring robust electrical solutions, including power supply systems, UPS, control panels, EMC, cable segregation, earthing and lightning protection

• 
contributing to transient studies, emergency shutdown (ESD) strategies, Cause & Effect philosophies and system integrity

• 
participating in FAT, SAT, commissioning and site supervision activities

• 
ensuring compliance with applicable legislation, industry standards and ATEX requirements

You bring experience from large-scale and technically complex process or energy facilities

We are looking for an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer who has a proven track record of working on large-scale technical infrastructure projects and thrives in multidisciplinary environments where engineering disciplines, regulatory requirements and multiple stakeholders must come together.

You have at least five years of hands-on experience with the design, construction and commissioning of electrical installations at major process, energy or industrial facilities operating under the ATEX Directive. You are accustomed to taking technical solutions from concept through to safe, reliable and operational installations, with practical experience across the entire project lifecycle – not just the design phase.

Your background may come from industries such as Power-to-X, refineries, biogas, oil and gas, process manufacturing or other large-scale energy and process facilities. Your specific industry background is less important than your experience delivering projects of a comparable size and technical complexity to the Danish Hydrogen Backbone.

In addition, we expect you:

• 
have extensive experience with electrical installations in ATEX environments

• 
have a solid understanding of Danish legislation, industry standards and regulatory requirements relevant to electrical installations

• 
have experience performing technical reviews and preparing engineering documentation within complex EPC or EPCM projects

• 
work in a structured and systematic manner and are comfortable taking technical ownership

• 
communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing

• 
are eligible to obtain Danish security clearance

• 
hold a valid Category B driving licence

Danish does not need to be your native language. However, we expect you to have previous professional experience working in Denmark and to be familiar with the Danish regulatory framework and industry standards applicable to major technical facilities.

Join one of Denmark's leading engineering teams

You will become part of the Project Engineering department in Gas Transmission – a multidisciplinary engineering team comprising specialists in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering and Instrumentation.

You will join a collaborative and highly technical environment where knowledge sharing, professional sparring and engineering excellence are integral to the way we work. At Energinet, you will have the opportunity to continuously develop your expertise through technically complex projects, internal specialist networks and close collaboration with some of the industry's most experienced engineers.

The position is based in either Ballerup or Egtved. During the current phase of the project, you should expect to spend one to two days per week at the project office in Ballerup, as well as undertaking occasional international travel to collaborate with project partners.

Ready to help shape the future of energy infrastructure?

At Energinet, you will become part of an organisation with a long-term perspective, where the solutions you help develop will play a vital role in Denmark's energy system for decades to come.

If you are motivated by technically complex projects, engineering excellence and the opportunity to contribute to the green transition through the development of critical energy infrastructure, we would love to hear from you.

Connectivity, IoT Core, & SIM Lifecycle

On behalf of our customer Circle Gas we are seeking a Mid-level Software Engineer to join their Virtual Device team. This team is the heartbeat of our operation, responsible for the interface between our smart devices and our applications. In this role, you will help build the "nervous system" of their IoT network.

You will work heavily with AWS IoT Core to manage telemetry ingestion and command structures, ensuring their digital twins accurately reflect the physical state of millions of meters. A specific focus of this role will be managing the lifecycle of SIM cards and ensuring robust meter connectivity.

As an Software Engineer, you will be expected to own the delivery of features within your team, write and debug code that affects large parts of our systems, and actively participate in design discussions.

Key Responsibilities

• Core Development: Write, test, and deploy high-quality code (Python & TypeScript) for their virtual device microservices using AWS Serverless technologies (Lambda, DynamoDB, etc.)

• IoT & Connectivity: Implement and maintain telemetry ingestion pipelines and command/control interfaces using AWS IoT Core

• SIM Lifecycle Management: Build and refine the logic for managing SIM card activation, deactivation, and status monitoring to ensure uninterrupted meter connectivity

• System Reliability: Ensure the production readiness of your code; monitor telemetry flows and debug connectivity issues across the fleet

• Collaboration: Work closely with firmware engineers and the data team to understand data payloads and ensure seamless integration

• Team Growth: Actively contribute to the Circle Tech culture, participate in code reviews, and share knowledge with the team

• Infrastructure as Code: Utilize Terraform to manage and deploy infrastructure, ensuring repeatable and secure environments

Qualifications

• Experience: Proven experience in software engineering (typically aligned with L4 expectations: delivering features independently and understanding the broader system)

• Tech Stack: Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript

• Cloud Native: Hands-on experience with AWS Serverless architectures (Lambda, API Gateway) and EventDriven Design

• IoT Knowledge: Experience with AWS IoT Core or similar MQTT-based telemetry systems is highly desirable

• Mindset: You thrive in a maturing "scale-up" environment—you are comfortable with some ambiguity and eager to help establish better processes

About Circle Gas

Circle Gas is a revolutionary company focused on transforming the lives of people in sub-Saharan Africa and beyond.

We are scaling rapidly to support 2 million households (10 million people), providing clean, safe, and affordable cooking fuel. Data is the lifeblood of our operation—from billing 10 million customers to optimizing logistics in remote areas.

Are you an experienced project manager with a passion for engineering and continuous improvement? Join C&D Foods (Denmark) A/S as our new Engineering Project Manager and take the lead on CAPEX, engineering, and optimisation projects across the site.

In this role, you will drive technical development and ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget—supporting operational excellence and the future growth of our business.

About the Position

As Engineering Project Manager, you will lead technical projects from concept to implementation, working closely with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, and external partners to deliver safe, high-quality solutions on time and within budget.

This is a key role in driving technical development, process improvements, and operational excellence across the site while supporting a strong One Team culture. You will play an important part in delivering CAPEX investments, improving plant performance, and identifying innovative solutions that support the site's future growth and sustainability goals.

Your key areas of responsibility:

• Delivery of projects on time and within budget

• Successful implementation of CAPEX initiatives

• Reduction in downtime and improvement in equipment reliability

Examples of tasks could include:

• Project Management & Technical Leadership: Lead engineering and CAPEX projects from concept to implementation, ensuring technical improvements, operational reliability, OEE optimisation, and effective coordination of internal and external stakeholders.

• Health, Safety & Compliance: Ensure compliance with HSE, GMP, and HACCP requirements, including risk assessments and contractor management processes.

• Financial Management: Manage CAPEX budgets and deliver projects within agreed financial parameters.

• Continuous Improvement & Collaboration: Drive process optimisation, energy efficiency, and Lean initiatives, support sustainability goals, and foster effective communication and strong relationships across the organisation and with external partners.

Candidate profile

• Relevant engineering qualification within Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or similar discipline

• Proven experience managing engineering or technical projects within a manufacturing environment (experience from the food production industry is highly valued)

• Strong leadership and organisational skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Financial and commercial awareness

• Experience with CAPEX management and contractor coordination

• Strong IT and project management system skills

We offer

You will become part of the C&D Foods family, an international company with a multicultural environment, across nationalities and cross-functional teams, where collaboration, diversity, and inclusion are part of everyday life. We prioritize employee well-being, work-life balance, and personal development. We also offer health and dental insurance to all employees and value a workplace culture built on respect, openness, and genuine care.

How to apply

Please send your CV along with a motivated application describing your interest in the position. If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact:

Emma Scheel Jensen, HR Learning & Development Specialist

E-mail: Emma.Jensen@cdfoods.com

About C&D Foods

C&D Foods is one of Europe’s leading producers of private label pet food, manufacturing a wide range of both wet and dry food. The company’s headquarters are located in Mullingar, County Westmeath.

As part of ABP Food Group, C&D Foods has grown to become one of the industry’s leading pet food manufacturers.

C&D Foods currently operates 9 production facilities across 7 countries (Ireland, United Kingdom, France, Denmark, Austria, Spain, and the Netherlands) as well as 2 sales offices in Manchester and Italy.

Service Desk Technician - Network

Would you like to work hands-on with B2B network operations and help keep critical digital infrastructure running? In this role, you will take ownership of customer cases, troubleshoot network-related issues and make sure the right actions are taken when services are affected.

What you need to succeed

• Relevant education in IT/ networking.

• Experience working with network products and a good understanding of network structures.

• Professional communication skills in both Danish and English.

• Experience working in a structured way with operational cases, where you prioritise according to SLAs and business criticality.

About the role and the team

You will join a specialised team supporting GlobalConnect’s B2B customers within network and security services. Based primarily at our Copenhagen office, you will work closely with colleagues to solve incidents, share knowledge and ensure effective handovers.

The role combines technical troubleshooting with customer communication. You will be responsible for keeping cases moving from the first contact through follow-up, resolution or the correct handover.

The role follows a planned 24/7 shift rotation with a mix of daytime, evening and night shift****s, including evening shifts around 15–23 and night shifts around 23–07. Weekend shifts are also part of the rotation.

The schedule is planned in advance and includes longer periods of consecutive days off, including full weeks off at certain points in the rotation. This gives you a combination of varied working hours and longer stretches of time away from work.

What you’ll be working on

• Receive and handle B2B customer enquiries by phone and through our systems.

• Take ownership of cases and prioritise them according to severity, SLAs, escalations and business criticality.

• Troubleshoot and work proactively with incidents and alarms related to network and security products.

• Follow up with customers and suppliers in accordance with agreed SLAs.

• Ensure clear handovers between shifts, colleagues and departments.

• Contribute to quality assurance of customer solutions and participate in customer meetings when needed.

Who we are looking for

You enjoy combining technical problem-solving with customer contact and take responsibility for moving your cases forward. You can maintain an overview when priorities change or a customer situation becomes critical, and you communicate technical information clearly to people with different levels of technical knowledge.

Experience from telecommunications or IT would be useful, as would knowledge of SD-WAN, Layer 2 and Layer 3. Experience with Cisco, Juniper or similar network equipment, ServiceNow, ITIL or network certifications such as CCNA, JNCIA or ACMA would also be an advantage.

Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you.

Our recruitment process

• Talent Acquisition Screening Interview

• Hiring Manager interview

• Personality and ability tests feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition

• References

• Final alignment meeting

Practical information

• Location: Copenhagen.

• The role is primarily office-based.

• GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this role.

You will get the opportunity to work with B2B network and security services, take ownership of operational customer cases and collaborate closely with colleagues in a specialised team.

No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!
